title: control-loop: resolve the role prompt against every installed skill root, not just the bee source tree
action: read_prompt_file (control_loop.rs:413) joins <main-root>/skills/bee-herding/references/<role>-prompt.md, a layout that exists ONLY in the bee source repo. Every host project installs the skill tree under a runtime prefix instead (.claude/skills, .agents/skills, .opencode/skills, .codex/skills - see PROJECT_SKILL_ROOTS at devtools/plugin_distribution.rs:39), so dispatch, merge and supervisor all die with 'prompt file not found'. Reproduced live: `bee herding control-loop --role supervisor --once` in the waggledance host repo errors with that exact message. Replace the single join with an ordered candidate search: a module-level const of skill-root prefixes in the order [skills, .claude/skills, .agents/skills, .opencode/skills, .codex/skills], each joined with bee-herding/references/<role>-prompt.md, first readable file wins. Keep skills/ FIRST so the bee source repo's behaviour and every existing path assertion stay byte-identical. When no candidate reads, the error must name EVERY path tried so a cold operator sees where bee looked - update the existing missing_prompt_file_is_an_error_not_a_panic assertion to the new wording rather than deleting it. Add tests: (1) a host-repo layout with the prompt ONLY under .claude/skills resolves it; (2) the bee-repo layout under skills/ still resolves and still wins when both exist; (3) an empty root errors with a message naming all five candidate paths. Keep the doc comment on read_prompt_file honest about the new search order and why skills/ leads.

truths: A host repo with the prompt only under .claude/skills/bee-herding/references resolves it
The bee source repo layout (skills/) still resolves and still takes precedence
A root with no prompt anywhere errors naming every candidate path that was tried
Every pre-existing control_loop test stays green without loosening what it asserts
All three roles - dispatch, merge, supervisor - go through the one fixed reader
